patterns.title: View type grouping and reordering
patterns.documented_behavior: Group tabs by view type, including from overflow when the bar is full. Reorder horizontally by dragging; edit access required.
patterns.proposed_qa: Check keyboard alternative, overflow, ordering persistence and permission denial.

patterns.title: Visible property search and quick filter
patterns.documented_behavior: Searchable fields depend on visible columns and supported textual types. Search preferences are workspace-wide; a hover filter applies a visible value.
patterns.proposed_qa: Disclose search scope, include hidden-column tests, keyboard/touch alternative, and distinguish zero matches from missing permissions.

patterns.title: Timeline secondary grouping
patterns.documented_behavior: Primary grouping constrains Assignee/List secondary options; nested rows expand/collapse; single-List scope does not gain nested List rows.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test incompatible options, save, collapsed state, counts and scope.

patterns.title: Filter-derived creation defaults
patterns.documented_behavior: Supported active filters prefill newly created tasks. For single-value groups, filters remove nonmatching groups even when the same task has multiple values.
patterns.proposed_qa: Preview defaults, avoid silently mutating existing objects, test contradictory filters and duplicate projections.

patterns.title: Dashboard and card filter draft
patterns.documented_behavior: Global and card-specific filters may be combined. Nested boolean groups use independent operators; apply commits draft, reset reverts to last applied, clear removes criteria.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test AND/OR truth tables, draft reset, scopes, counts and empty/error states.

patterns.title: Reversible archive versus deletion
patterns.documented_behavior: Archiving removes an item from ordinary views without deleting it, including attached files; archived search and unarchive are available.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test archived-only search, restore, attachment access and permission; separate permanent deletion.

patterns.title: Done versus closed semantics
patterns.documented_behavior: Done stops overdue notices, clears blocking dependencies and counts completion but retains visibility. Home List controls status schema across projections.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test visible done versus closed, dependencies, metric consistency and multiple-list projection.

patterns.title: Activity event filtering and comments
patterns.documented_behavior: Separate conversation and full history panels; filter history by person or event category, unread dot for comments, action items show assigned comments.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test audit completeness, filtering, unread behavior and focus. Migration wording in source is inconsistent.

patterns.title: Threaded comment visibility
patterns.documented_behavior: Thread replies may be hidden when threaded comments are disabled and reappear on re-enable. Follower and unread controls are distinct.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test notification scope, disabled-feature data preservation, thread access and re-enable.

patterns.title: Status template fork semantics
patterns.documented_behavior: Editing an existing status template applies to current location; other users of template retain current custom statuses rather than receiving update.
patterns.proposed_qa: Disclose affected locations before save, test schema identity and old-status mapping.

patterns.title: Template library copy
patterns.documented_behavior: Community template is added to workspace as customizable copy; source remains available. Guest access varies by type.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test copy independence, version/provenance, permissions and duplicate names.

patterns.title: Personal document tray
patterns.documented_behavior: Minimize a document to personal tray, reopen by click, remove using hover X or document control. Version-specific terminology.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test one ID per object, close versus unpin, keyboard/touch, unsaved edits and navigation; not evidence of tabs.

reviewed_sources.summary: Group by view type via location settings or overflow menu when full; horizontal drag reorder requires full edit permissions.
Search covers eight textual field types only if visible as columns; search preferences apply to workspace views; hover value quick filter in List.
Second-level Assignee/List choices depend on primary group and location; collapse parent rows; List-level grouping does not add nested rows.
Supported filters prefill new objects; single-value grouping hides nonmatching groups; separate subtasks mode makes them searchable.
Dashboard/card filter scopes can coexist; nested AND/OR, apply, reset to last applied, clear group/all.
Archive preserves task and attached files; archived tasks searchable via views and command bar; unarchive restores access to attachments.
Done remains visible, stops overdue reminders, clears waiting dependencies and counts toward goals.
Right icon rail separates Comments from full Activity; unread dot; assigned comments also appear in action items. Article has inconsistent migration wording.
Filter history by actor and change type, including moves, properties, dependencies, sharing and Git events.
Threads have unread counts, follower settings and scheduled replies; disabling threaded comments hides old threaded replies until re-enabled.
Editing a shared template applies only locally; other locations retain previous statuses as Custom. Guests cannot edit or apply templates.
Tasks in multiple Lists keep home List status schema; two statuses use checkmark icon, more use square; order configurable at schema and view levels.
Quick create from global toolbar/command bar, comments and Chat; access and details depend on surface.
Personal Tray stores minimized Docs and tasks; click reopen, hover X remove. Do not assume same label in new layout.
Community templates can be copied to workspace library, renamed and shared; original remains; available object types depend on entry and role.
